0.comment: Princess of Sal Vindagnyr: Princess' Box
0.content: Three boxes found on Dragonspine, each narrated by a different person from Sal Vindagnyr's last days. The Princess' Box holds her admission that she cannot finish the fresco and her apology to her father and to Ukko; the Priest's Box holds Varuch's hope that the third painting will show thawing ice; the Scribe's Box holds Ukko's bitter wish to see the heavens burn. Together they open a secret room.

1.comment: Princess of Sal Vindagnyr: Frostbearing Tree
1.content: The great silver-white tree beneath which the princess was born, once linked to an Irminsul tree. A fragment of the Skyfrost Nail shattered it. After Durin's blood soaked into the ground, the tree stirred and, when the Traveler offered a crimson essence, bore a single fruit as a memorial to the dead of Sal Vindagnyr.

2.comment: Princess of Sal Vindagnyr: Imunlaukr and the Starsilver greatsword
2.content: A hero from another land who lived in Sal Vindagnyr and was close to the princess. She gave him a Starsilver greatsword to shatter the ice; he left to find a way to save the nation, and returned to find everyone dead. He left the sword among the frescoes and went to look for war to lose himself in.
